featured_reviews.name: Ishika Chari
featured_reviews.review_text:
As a graphic design student, I understand how to properly set up print documents and export files correctly. That’s why this experience was even more disappointing. The printed colors were completely different from the original design — the purple tones turned greyish, affecting the entire look of the magazine. When I raised the issue, I was told that “Mumbai temperature” and “machine temperature” affected the printing, which honestly did not feel like a professional explanation for such a major color shift.

Instead of taking proper responsibility, I was asked to pay again for reprinting without any assurance that the issue would actually be fixed. They also kept the bill and did not return it, which reduced my trust further. I understand minor print variations can happen, but proper color management, communication, and customer support are equally important in professional printing.
